id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_100.pack|cs_:
"I heard it all from my retainers and Jade.
  While caught in that nightmare,
  I must have been a terrible king...

"Without you, this kingdom... no, this world
  would have been burned by Mordegon,
  and life on earth would have died out.

"{var:1}! You defeated the evil source,
  Mordegon, and saved Erdrea!

"You are worthy to bear the name
  of Erdwin, the Luminary of old!
  I bestow upon you the title of Luminary!

"...Sorry. Being here with everyone
  like this just makes me feel
  so happy somehow...

"Oh, Sister. We've always
  been together, haven't we?
"Yes, you're right. How odd of me...

"I sense a tremendous evil presence...
  This power... where does it come from?

"Come to think of it, Mordegon said
  something strange at the end.

"'Don't think you're the only one who
  traveled back in time.' What did that mean...

"Your Majesty, it's urgent!
  Please hurry to the balcony at once!

"{var:1}! I'll go ahead to the
  third-floor balcony! Hurry and follow!
